headline: You only text 'hey' every few hours to make sure I'm still here. That's not love, that's a HEARTBEAT.
caption:
You only text 'hey' every few hours to make sure I'm still here. That's not love, that's a HEARTBEAT.

—
HEARTBEAT: a small signal sent at regular intervals to say it is still running.
